change_log.value: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition

GOV-F-004-S64.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S64.description: Define a strict audit log schema including operation type, actor (GPT/Claude/system), timestamp, input/output payload hashes, trace_id, parent_trace_id, and immutability flags. Enforce schema validation via Pydantic and MongoDB collection validation rules.

GOV-F-004-S65.title: Core Append-Only Audit Logging Service
GOV-F-004-S65.description: Build a centralized audit logging service that all components call to write audit events. Service must enforce append-only writes, generate trace IDs, hash sensitive payloads, and standardize event structure across GPT, Claude, and pipeline operations.

GOV-F-004-S66.title: Audit Logging Test Coverage
GOV-F-004-S66.description: Implement unit and integration tests validating append-only guarantees, schema enforcement, trace continuity across services, and failure handling. Include negative tests for attempted updates/deletes and malformed audit entries.
